cards.name: Nameplates
cards.description: HeadsUp's nameplates: names, levels, icons and the rest, as each kind's page designs them.

settings.name: Base Font Size
settings.tip: Every line's text size is a percent of this.

settings.name: Default Font
settings.tip: The font of every line whose own font is Default.

settings.name: Base Icon Size
settings.tip: Every line's icon size is a percent of this.

settings.name: Auto-Check
settings.tip: Checks each mob that comes near by itself, so its exact level and difficulty show, and keeps the check's line out of the chat log. Players are not checked: the server tells a player who examined them.

settings.name: Replace Dashes (-)
settings.tip: What a dash typed in a nameplate design, or between the two ends of a level or a difficulty, is drawn as.

options.name: No
options.tip: Dashes stay dashes.
A dot.
A square.
A diamond, as at the middle of an ornament.

settings.name: Scale with Distance
settings.tip: Sizes follow how far a name's owner is from you.

settings.name: Min Size
settings.tip: The smallest a far name shrinks to.

settings.name: Max Size
settings.tip: The largest a near name grows to.

settings.name: Scale Your Own Name
settings.tip: Off, your own nameplate keeps one size as the camera zooms.

settings.name: Vertical Offset
settings.tip: How far above the game's own spot names sit.

settings.name: Stack Names
settings.tip: Names that would cover each other rise one over another. Your target's keeps its place.

cards.name: Outline Style
cards.description: Colored borders around mobs, and anything else whose rows ask for one.

settings.name: Smoothness
settings.tip: Higher is rounder and costs a little more.

settings.name: Range
settings.tip: Anything farther gets no outline.

settings.name: Fade In
settings.tip: Outlines grow fainter with distance: whole within {near} yalms, almost gone at the range.

settings.name: Outlines are unavailable: the depth buffer has no stencil bits.

cards.name: Target Cursor
cards.description: The cursor above your target's nameplate.

options.name: Vanilla
options.tip: Uses the vanilla target cursor. WARNING: May have issues if the vanilla target frame is hidden.

options.name: Triangle
options.tip: Uses a simple triangle target cursor, that looks similar to the vanilla target cursor.

options.name: Phoenix Feather
options.tip: Uses a phoenix feather icon as the target cursor.

options.name: Chocobo
options.tip: Uses the PlayOnline mouse pointer as the target cursor.
Uses a custom icon as the target cursor.

settings.name: Outline Thickness
settings.tip: Its dark edge.

settings.name: Scale
settings.tip: Larger the nearer your target is.

settings.name: Float
settings.tip: It bobs up and down. Off, it stays still.

settings.name: Vertical Offset
settings.tip: How far over its place the cursor sits, or under it.

settings.name: Color
settings.tip: The cursor's color. Over anything that has no such color, as a player's aggression, it is the Targeting color.

settings.name: Edge Color
settings.tip: The cursor's edge.

cards.name: Colors: Aggression
cards.description: Colors indicating whether an enemy will attack you, or not, and if they are a notorious monster.

cards.name: Colors: Toughness
cards.description: Colors indicating how dangerous an enemy is to you at your current level. Easy Prey covers Incredibly Easy Prey, and Very Tough covers Incredibly Tough.

cards.name: Colors: Claim Status
cards.description: Colors indicating whether or not the mob is claimed, and who is the owner of the claim.

cards.name: Colors: Targeting
cards.description: Colors indicating whether you are targeting the entity, locked onto it, sub-targeting, etc. The target cursor takes these too.

rows.name: Sub-Target
rows.tip: Picking for a spell, ability or trade.

rows.name: Out of Range
rows.tip: A sub-target out of the spell or ability's range.

cards.name: Colors: Entity Type
cards.description: Colors indicating what type of entity the target is, or what their relation is to you.

cards.name: Screenshot Mode
cards.description: Every name, the top panel and every addon window go, as with /hu screenshot. Ashita's /screenshot hide turns it on by itself for its picture.

settings.name: Key
settings.tip: Turns screenshot mode on and off. The game sees the key too, so pick one it does not use.

settings.name: Hide Game Windows
settings.tip: The game's own windows and chat go too.

words.name: Windows in a group move by its offset together, keeping their places beside each other. Each window's own X and Y below still moves it within the group.

words.tip: Under Bar: the whole group goes below the help bar.
Removes the group; its windows stay where the game puts them.

settings.name: Every Window
settings.tip: Every window that opens under the bar goes below it, not only those switched on or grouped.

settings.name: Game Help
settings.tip: The game's own help bar goes under the top panel, and the windows under it. Off while it is hidden.

words.name: HeadsUp Defaults
words.tip: Every window under the bar, the game's help too, in the groups the game opens them in. Offsets are cleared.

words.name: HeadsUp Help
words.tip: HeadsUp's help text in place of the game's help bar, which is hidden, and every window under it.

words.name: Game Defaults
words.tip: Every window where the game puts it: nothing moved, no groups, no offsets.

words.name: Under Bar takes a window below the help bar, all together; X and Y move it from where the game puts it. Type a number, then Enter.

words.tip: Every window the game has, not only the named ones and yours.
Under Bar, then its X and Y offset.

cards.name: Top Panel
cards.description: Hover a widget for details; click it to keep them open. The Widgets page has each one's options.

settings.name: Text Size
settings.tip: Auto follows the height. Too large for two lines, the second line goes as One Line says.

settings.name: One Line
settings.tip: On a bar too short for two lines, each widget's second line goes before or after its title, or is left off.

settings.name: Popup Size
settings.tip: Auto follows the height.

settings.name: Hide Readout
settings.tip: The game's S, R and % numbers at the top right.

cards.name: Help Bar
cards.description: The game's help text, in a bar of its own under the top panel.

settings.name: Hide Game Help
settings.tip: The game's own help bar, which the top panel covers.

settings.name: Position
settings.tip: Pixels from its place under the top panel.

settings.name: Background
settings.tip: Off, the help text alone, with no bar behind it.

cards.name: Widgets
cards.description: A tab for each widget, with its options.

rows.name: Details
rows.tip: Aggro icons after the name, weaknesses after the level.

rows.name: Time Zone
rows.tip: Local is your computer's. Another zone goes before the time, as in PDT 21:07.

rows.name: Server Time
rows.tip: Japan's time, which the server keeps and the resets go by, as a second line under your own.

rows.name: Seconds
rows.tip: On your own line.

rows.name: Layout
rows.tip: Which is the larger line, your jobs and levels or your EXP, with the other under it; or the EXP alone.

rows.name: Job Names
rows.tip: Off, the levels alone.

rows.name: Latency
rows.tip: After the rates, once measured.

cards.name: Layout
cards.description: Drag a chip to move it; click it to open its tab above.

settings.name: Reset Layout
settings.tip: Puts every widget back in its first place. Switches stay.

settings.name: Chocobo
settings.tip: PlayOnline's chocobo as the mouse pointer.

settings.name: Pointer Fix
settings.tip: Keeps the game's pointer under yours after a resize, and clicks where you click. It also shows the pointer again over Ashita's windows.

settings.name: Keep Pointer
settings.tip: The game hides its pointer when a key runs a command. While only these keys are held, it stays.

settings.name: Theme
settings.tip: The window's colors and light.

settings.name: Font
settings.tip: Titles stay in the bar's font.

settings.name: Size
settings.tip: Drag its corner to resize the window.

settings.name: Window Opacity
settings.tip: How much of the game shows through this window.

settings.name: Reset All Settings
settings.tip: Every setting on every page back to its default.

words.name: Every setting goes back to its default. This cannot be undone.

cards.name: HeadsUp
cards.description: All of HeadsUp, as /hu on and /hu off.

settings.name: Debug Report
settings.tip: As /hu debug: writes a report to logs/headsup.

cards.name: Visibility
cards.description: What each kind of entity shows, and whether it gets an outline.

rows.name: Aggressive
rows.tip: Would attack you at your level. Too Weak mobs only attack while you sit or rest.

rows.name: Passive
rows.tip: Passive, or aggressive but Too Weak for you.

rows.name: NM (Aggressive)
rows.tip: Notorious monsters that would attack you.

rows.name: NM (Passive)
rows.tip: Notorious monsters that would leave you alone.

rows.name: NM (Placeholder)
rows.tip: Lottery placeholders, whose death can pop an NM, while nobody has claimed them.

rows.name: Claimed (Yours)
rows.tip: Claimed by you or your party, whatever else it is.

rows.name: Claimed (Others')
rows.tip: Claimed by anyone outside your party, whatever else it is.

rows.name: Dead
rows.tip: Dead, until its body is gone. It keeps its name alone.

rows.name: No Data
rows.tip: Not in the Phoenix data.

rows.name: Players
rows.tip: Every player the rows below do not cover.

rows.name: Party Members
rows.tip: In your party.

rows.name: Friends
rows.tip: On your Friend List in the game (Communication > Friend List), and not in your party.

rows.name: Linkshell Members
rows.tip: In your linkshell, and neither in your party nor a friend. The game tells a player's linkshell only when you /check them.

rows.name: Your Pets
rows.tip: A pet of yours.

rows.name: Party Pets
rows.tip: A pet of someone in your party.

rows.name: Friend Pets
rows.tip: A pet of a friend who is not in your party.

rows.name: Others' Pets
rows.tip: Anyone else's pet.

cards.name: Outline Design
cards.description: Each row's outline color: a custom color, or one of the palettes by the entity's state.

settings.tip: This row's outline color: your own, or a palette on the Entities page.

cards.name: Nameplate Design
cards.description: Design this entity's nameplate by writing in the text box and by dragging and dropping tags from below. Drop a tag onto another and the two share that place: the left one is drawn when it has something to show, and the next one when it has not. Drag a tag out of the lines to remove it.

settings.name: Max Icons Shown
settings.tip: The most status icons a nameplate shows, counted along its lines from the top. GM's always shows.

cards.name: Line Style
cards.description: How each line is drawn. A line's tab holds its settings.

rows.name: Sync Line Style
rows.tip: Borrows every setting below from another line, so the two always match. A line that borrows from this one is not offered.

rows.name: Line Visibility
rows.tip: When this line shows: always, or when any checked condition holds.

rows.name: Alignment
rows.tip: Where the line sits against the bottom line. A line wider than it hangs past its other end.

rows.name: Font
rows.tip: The line's font. Default is the font on the Entities page.

rows.name: Font Style
rows.tip: Any of the three together.

rows.name: Text Size
rows.tip: Of the base font size on the Entities page.

rows.name: Icon Size
rows.tip: Every icon on this line, of the base icon size on the Entities page.

rows.name: Padding
rows.tip: Extra space under this line, which moves it and what is above it up.
rows.tipBottomLine: Extra space over this line, which moves the lines above it up.

rows.name: Text Color
rows.tip: The text's color: your own, the game's, or a palette by the entity's state.

rows.name: Shadow Strength
rows.tip: The dark, soft shadow behind the letters that keeps them readable over bright ground. 0 is none.

rows.name: Shadow Color
rows.tip: The shadow's color; black as a rule.

rows.name: Glow Strength
rows.tip: A colored halo around the letters, as a mob's name glows in its outline color. 0 is none.

rows.name: Glow Size
rows.tip: How far the halo spreads.

rows.name: Glow Color
rows.tip: The halo's color.

tip.mobs: No glow on this line once you or your party has claimed the mob.
tip.players: No glow on this line while the player has their weapon out.
tip.self: No glow on this line while you have your weapon out.
tip.npcs: No glow on this line while the NPC is fighting.
tip.pets: No glow on this line while the pet is fighting.

words.name: Do Not Sync
words.tip: This line keeps a style of its own.

words.name: Sync with {line}
words.tip: Every setting below is the {line}'s, so the two always match.

cards.name: Ornament
cards.description: A diamond rule over, under or between the nameplate's lines.

rows.name: Visibility
rows.tip: Where the ornament goes, if anywhere.

rows.name: Width
rows.tip: The rule's length, before the distance scale.

rows.name: Height
rows.tip: The diamond's height.

rows.name: Color
rows.tip: Its color: your own, or a palette by the entity's state.

cards.name: Nameplate Opacity
cards.description: Changes the opacity of the nameplate depending on what you are targeting.

settings.name: No Target
settings.tip: If you have no target, use this opacity for all nameplates.

settings.name: Not Targeted
settings.tip: If you have a target, but this is not your target, use this opacity for the nameplate.

settings.name: Is Targeted
settings.tip: If this is your target, use this opacity for the nameplate, at any distance.

settings.name: Fade In
settings.tip: Nameplates grow fainter with distance: at the opacity above within {near} yalms, almost gone at the range. Your target's never fades.

settings.name: Range
settings.tip: Where a nameplate that fades in is almost gone.

cards.name: Detection Icons
cards.description: Which icons the Detection tag shows: aggression, linking and how it senses you, in MobDB's icons.

cards.name: Badges
cards.description: The small text on the icons of the Weaknesses, Resistances, Statuses and Immunities tags. The Target widget's popup takes its ranks and colors from here too.

settings.name: Use Rank System
settings.tip: Phoenix's ranks, -3 to 11, instead of percents. -3 is +50% and 4 is -50%.

cards.name: Weaknesses
cards.description: Which elements the Weaknesses and Resistances tags show beside the damage types.

settings.name: Weak From
settings.tip: The least element weakness that gets a badge.

settings.name: Resist From
settings.tip: The least element resistance that gets a badge.

settings.name: Max Elements
settings.tip: Past this many, those nearest neutral are left off.

cards.name: Statuses
cards.description: Which statuses the Statuses tag shows, weak or resisted.

settings.name: Respawn Timers
settings.tip: Above your name, a countdown for each placeholder you see die, as Bigmouth Billy [11A] 3:15. It reads "up" when due.

settings.name: Timer Size
settings.tip: Of the base font size on the Entities page.

options.name: Hide Nameplate
options.tip: No name at all.

options.name: Show Nameplate
options.tip: HeadsUp's nameplate.

options.name: When Targeted
options.tip: The nameplate while it is your target, and no name otherwise.

options.name: Vanilla Nameplate
options.tip: The game's own name, and nothing of HeadsUp's.

options.name: No Outline
options.tip: No outline.

options.name: Show Outline
options.tip: An outline whenever it is in range.

options.name: When Targeted
options.tip: An outline while it is your target.

options.name: Inherit
options.tip: The outline its aggression gives it, as any other mob's.
options.tipOnClaimRows: The outline it would have unclaimed.

options.name: Custom
options.tip: A color of your own.

options.name: Vanilla Color
options.tip: The color the game gives the name.

options.name: Color by Aggression
options.tip: Colors indicating whether an enemy will attack you, or not, and if they are a notorious monster.

options.name: Color by Toughness
options.tip: Colors indicating how dangerous an enemy is to you at your current level.

options.name: Color by Claim Status
options.tip: Colors indicating whether or not the mob is claimed, and who is the owner of the claim.

options.name: Color by Targeting
options.tip: Colors indicating whether you are targeting the entity, locked onto it, sub-targeting, etc.

options.name: Color by Entity Type
options.tip: Colors indicating what type of entity the target is, or what their relation is to you.

options.name: When Targeted
options.tip: While it is your target.

options.name: When Unclaimed
options.tip: While nobody has claimed the mob.

options.name: When Claimed by You
options.tip: While you or your party has claimed the mob.

options.name: When Claimed by Others
options.tip: While someone outside your party has claimed the mob.

options.name: When Engaged in Combat
options.tip: While it is fighting.

options.name: When Too Weak
options.tip: While the mob is too weak to be worth experience.

options.name: When Aggressive
options.tip: While the mob would attack you.

options.name: When Passive
options.tip: While the mob would leave you alone.

options.name: When Party Member
options.tip: While the player is in your party.

options.name: When Friend
options.tip: While the player is a friend.

options.name: When Linkshell Member
options.tip: While the player is in your linkshell.

options.name: When Owner is You
options.tip: While the pet is yours.

options.name: Disabled
options.tip: No ornament.

options.name: Top
options.tip: Over the nameplate's first line.

options.name: Above Middle Line
options.tip: Between the top and middle lines, while both show.

options.name: Below Middle Line
options.tip: Between the middle and bottom lines, while both show.

options.name: Bottom
options.tip: Under the nameplate's last line.

options.name: Phoenix Gold
options.tip: An ornate strip in dark brown and gold, with diamonds between its widgets.

options.name: Umbra Dark
options.tip: Each widget in a grey pill, lit in blue.

options.name: Phoenix Red, Ornate
options.tip: The ornate strip in Phoenix's dark red.

options.name: Phoenix Red, Pills
options.tip: Each widget in a pill, in Phoenix's dark red.

options.name: Aurora
options.tip: Slate glass, lit from cyan into violet.

options.name: Phoenix
options.tip: Phoenix's dark red, lit in its royal red.

options.name: Aurora
options.tip: Slate glass, lit from cyan into violet.

options.name: Zone
options.tip: The zone, its region and who holds it. Hover for the influence there and the conquest tally.

options.name: Weather
options.tip: The weather now and today's chance of it. Hover for the forecast.

options.name: Vana'diel
options.tip: The Vana'diel day, time and moon.

options.name: Target
options.tip: Your target's name, level and con. Hover a mob for its details.

options.name: Gil
options.tip: Gil, or another currency. Hover for every currency.

options.name: Bags
options.tip: How full your inventory is. Hover for every bag.

options.name: Clock
options.tip: Your computer's time, or another time zone's, over the server's if you like. Hover for the daily reset and conquest tally.

options.name: Game Help
options.tip: The game's help text, in a bar of its own under the top panel.

options.name: FPS
options.tip: Frames per second. Hover for frame times.

options.name: Job
options.tip: Jobs, levels and EXP to the next level, with a bar. Hover for EXP per hour.

options.name: Connection
options.tip: Bytes sent and received each second; amber or red when data stops. Hover for latency.

options.name: Party
options.tip: Party size and the lowest HP and MP. Hover for each member.

options.name: Signet
options.tip: Time left on Signet or Sanction, while one is on.

options.name: Distance
options.tip: How far your target is, in yalms.

words.name: These settings are the top panel's, which is off: the Top Panel page switches it on.
HeadsUp is off: the Debug page switches it on.
Always
words.tip: The line shows whatever else holds.
